name: Dread Hades
description: Ruler of the underworld abyss. Dread Hades drains the life force of its enemies with each rotation, feeding on fear and despair to grow ever more powerful.

ability.name: Soul Reaper
ability.description: Dread Hades tears open the underworld gate — drain 45 HP from the enemy (true damage, ignores defense), steal 4 of their stamina, and apply Cursed Ground: enemy takes 20 damage at the start of each of their next 3 turns.

special_move.name: Underworld Guillotine
special_move.description: The gates of Hades swing open — a crushing two-hit blow that shreds the soul itself, bypassing all defenses!
flavour_texts: 💀 **Underworld Guillotine** — the scythe of Hades cleaves through fate itself!
